title: Noise sensitivity bound
statement: For every natural number $n$, every linear threshold function $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and every noise parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\le 1/2$, the noise sensitivity of $f$ at parameter $\delta$ is at most $\sqrt{3/2}\,\sqrt{\delta}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a linear threshold function on $\{\pm1\}^n$
